plans.covers: OTIF per delivery: on time means arrived_ts between slot_start and slot_end; this checks the premise that a delivery arrived on 22 June and reports its on-time status.
OTIF per delivery: in full means every pick line of the shipment has cases_confirmed = cases_ordered; this reports line and case totals so the code can decide in-full for the 22 June delivery.

OTIF per delivery for June arrivals: on time is arrived_ts between slot_start and slot_end, and in full is every pick line of that shipment having cases_confirmed = cases_ordered; the code should count a delivery OTIF only when on_time is true and lines_in_full = pick_lines, then divide OTIF deliveries by all June deliveries.
Per-line OTIF cross-check for June arrivals: a pick line is OTIF when its shipment arrived within its slot and that line was confirmed in full; OTIF rate = otif_lines / pick_lines.
